notes: Five prompts should route to this skill and five are adjacent but out of scope, so both over-triggering and under-triggering are measurable.
Each probe runs with read-only tools in an empty directory. The routing decision is made from the description before any file is read, so the absence of a real repository does not affect it.
A probe is correct when the skill fired and was expected to, or did not fire and was not expected to.

prompts.prompt: Add a handler to the nginx role so the service reloads when its config template changes, and make sure the config task notifies it.
Review roles/postgres/tasks/main.yml and tell me whether the package pinning and the service restart logic are right.
Our collection's molecule scenario fails on the idempotence step. Find out which task reports changed on the second run and fix it.
Convert the short module names in this playbook to FQCN and make sure it still passes the repo's checks.
This role only supports Debian. Add RedHat support, including the different service and package names.
Review this Terraform module: the security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 and I want that tightened.
Lint this docker-compose.yml and fix the indentation so it parses cleanly.
Write a Python script that parses our static inventory file and prints the hosts grouped by their group name.
Our Kubernetes deployment manifest is missing CPU and memory resource limits. Add sensible ones.
Explain the practical differences between Puppet and Chef for configuration management.
